mentions.name: ZenBot Stock Scanner
mentions.description: A one-man built and maintained stock scanner that finds stocks with relative strength to the market. The front end is C#/Blazor and the back end is a C# console app doing intense parallel processing and data aggregation. It grew out of the builder's early attempts to algo-trade stocks and has a solid community following.
mentions.problem: Grew out of early attempts to algo-trade stocks, addressing the need to find stocks showing relative strength to the market.
